description: This file is a shell script that tests Git pack performance with multi-pack reuse, including functions to create multi-pack scenarios, manipulate git pack files, and evaluate performance and size in various configurations.

methods.name: find_pack
methods.description: Searches for a pack index containing a specific object by name.

methods.name: repack_into_n_chunks
methods.description: Creates a multi-pack scenario by repacking a Git repository into a specified number of chunks.
